faq.title:
Good questions.
Straight answers.
faq.lead: Every space is different. A conversation is the best way to work out the specifics.

items.q: What kind of fabrication can I ask for?
items.a: Gates, grills, shades and sheds, domes, and custom interior metal products for residential and commercial spaces.

items.q: Can I bring my own design or photo?
items.a: Yes. A reference photo or sketch helps us understand the look you want. We can discuss how it fits your space and what is practical to build.
Price depends on the size, material, finish and design of the work. Share your requirement and we will confirm scope and price in a quote before work starts.

items.q: How long will the work take?
items.a: Timelines depend on the type and size of the project. We confirm the expected timeline with you when you review the quote.

items.q: Where can I discuss my project?
items.a: Call 9428280683 to talk through your project. We work with homes and businesses in Jamnagar.
